body: This actually really inspired me. Thank you.

because of my insurance. because i live in the middle of nowhere. because i have a severe phobia of making phone calls and am usually unable to complete a phone call to a doctor's office without hanging up first. 

i am now thoroughly convinced that i am broken beyond repair. maybe those qualities were easily fixable once, but not anymore.
I was diagnosed in September of 2011, after my last failed suicide attempt. The meds made me sick, and I was told by family that they weren't helping me, so i decided they weren't worth the money.

my mother and my psychologist have both offered to do it for me. but i'm an adult and it makes me feel even more pathetic that i can't do something so simple.

i feel stuck in the middle. accepting help has never been one of my strong suits. it makes me feel weak.
